correctness.rationale: Cayley enumeration produces (k^{k-2}/k!)n d^{k-1}(1+O(1/d)) embedded trees. Exact incident-edge counts yield mean lambda=e^{-c}/(k k!). Disjoint embedded trees have joint isolation likelihood equal to product times q^{-b} with uniformly bounded b, and overlap is incompatible, so all factorial moments tend to lambda^r. Cyclic components have expected count O(p). k=1 has its own factorial moments, and k=2 isolated vertices have an exact vanishing relative variance. A Python checker passes 96 exact finite and finite-size analytic diagnostics. No step treats finite computation as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural sequence of disappearance windows for connected components of each fixed size is determined with logarithmic-logarithmic centers and exact geometry-independent constants, uniformly over connected or disconnected arbitrary regular hosts. The k=2 window also has diverging isolated vertices. These provide structurally informative connectivity obstructions beyond the isolated-vertex analysis of a recent band-percolation model.
